statements.t: Unlike traditional gene therapies and gene-editing technologies that target a single gene mutation, our modifier gene therapy platform is designed to address the underlying disease biology and potentially restore balance across multiple gene networks – potentially enabling us to address large, underserved patient populations rather than narrow single-gene subsets.

We completed enrollment in the Phase 2/3 pivotal confirmatory trial (N=63 subjects) early, in just nine months, and expect topline Phase 3 results in the second quarter of 2027, followed by a BLA submission in mid-2027.

We have incurred recurring operating losses, generated negative cash flows from operations, and expect to continue to incur significant expenditures to support the research, development, and potential commercialization of our product candidates.

Management believes these financing transactions strengthened our financial position and, based on our current cash, cash equivalents, and anticipated operating plans, provide us with increased flexibility to fund our operations and strategic priorities.

Management continues to evaluate and pursue plans to mitigate these conditions, which may include raising additional capital, managing the timing and scope of operating expenditures, pursuing strategic partnerships or licensing arrangements, and other financing or corporate transactions.

There can be no assurance that such plans will be successfully implemented, that additional financing will be available on acceptable terms, or at all, or that we will be able to execute our strategic plans within the required timeframe.
